scope: Before/after isolated native/source semantic comparison plus actual source-only prefix guard controls. No instruction matching or original OS loading claim.

before.scope:
Worklist factory live asset reads against unpatched native instructions.

The real allocator/initializer chain executes in Unicorn. Descriptor banks,
record/actor aliases and root/kind interventions are synthetic. Source prefix
guards are explicit read-only models for these unregistered banks and group0;
callbacks are models. No original OS module is loaded or started.

source_prefix_guards.scope: Fresh source-only spies and actual registered-prefix guards; no original file/module is supplied or loaded.
source_prefix_guards.stdout:
normal=1 middle=1 alternate=1 allocation_failure=1
last_asset=1 asset_guard=1 callback_guard=1 group_guard=1 unknown_tables=1
worklist_factory_cases=9 checks=9 failures=0

limits: Only group0 and synthetic unregistered asset/callback banks are covered by the native comparison; nine source-only tests separately retain actual prefix-boundary failures.
Descriptor/kind interventions and record/actor aliases test specific reload boundaries, not actual native capacities or callback bodies.
Callee argument homes may differ as ordinary C scratch space; return address, caller guards, ESP and preserved registers are checked.
No instruction matching, complete indexed-owner proof, original OS loading or full gameplay claim follows.
